headline: Fill empty hygiene chairs with no-show prediction and automatic waitlist backfill.
executive_summary:
Missed hygiene appointments are the largest controllable revenue leak at Maple Street Dental.

A risk model on existing booking history flags likely no-shows and backfills from a waitlist automatically.
why_it_wins: Uses data the practice already has

why_not_the_others.reason: Integration heavy for labor savings only
